# harness/scripts/test_design_planner_finish_steps.sh reads it: --list prints it; --step N grades the step's witnesses (the entry planner_finish__<name> of corpus/tests/<lang>'s master, its answer cut from the language's oracle; a language whose row has not absorbed it yet keeps the loose pair corpus/tests/<lang>/planner_finish/<name>.<ext> and .ref; this table moved here from corpus/tests/snobol4/planner_finish, the coo 2026-11-10, CIO-36) in both modes, then the probe tokens.

# probe tokens (every token must read green): afn=<callee,...> (util_emitter_memory_model_census.py --only A --list: the named callees' A-fn counts sum to 0) | afn_in=<fn>:<callee> (--only A --in <fn> --list: the callee's count is 0) | afn_notin=<fn>:<callee> (--not-in) | absent=<scope>:<regex> (grep -cE of the regex over scope src/emitter+src/templates (emit), src/planner (planner), src (all) reads 0) | present=<scope>:<regex> (reads >0) | regmax=<N> (emit.cpp calls bb_slot_register at most N times outside its definition) | dumps (--dump-plan and --dump-homes on the first witness print a PLAN_ROW and a HOME line) | zsmframe (SCRIP_ZSM=1 --compile of each witness prints a [ZSM-FRAME] line with addrs>0) | scoped=<fn,...> (--only A --in <fns> bar 0) | finish (bar 0, nm gate 0, the eight smokes).
